items.title: AI Product Integration
items.description: Implemented match suggestions, chat coaching, and icebreaker / bio generation with Claude, integrated into the production product flow; built a content-moderation pipeline with AWS Rekognition (synchronous for images, asynchronous for video) alongside real-person face verification.

items.title: End-to-End Product Delivery
items.description: Brought AI into the day-to-day development workflow and independently delivered a product across requirement planning, flow and UI design, AI implementation, backend services, and the iOS release — a scope that previously required separate frontend, backend, and admin-dashboard engineers, now shipped by one person within a single product cycle: in a single month on one product line I delivered a gifting system, a wheel-based lottery, black-card memberships, role-based admin access control, verification flows, and a revenue dashboard — a dozen-plus features — while maintaining two other product lines in parallel. Defined a North Star Metric, conducted competitive analysis, and used data to determine which features to retain and which to retire.

items.title: Node.js / TypeScript Full-Stack
items.description: Node.js / NestJS on the backend and React / Next.js on the frontend, sharing a single language across both. Also experienced with Flutter and React Native, and able to take a product from initial development through to release independently.

items.title: Architecture & Performance
items.description: Evaluating performance and scalability at the architecture level, identifying bottlenecks and proposing improvements. Experienced in MySQL query and index optimization, Redis caching design, asynchronous processing, and system load tuning.

items.title: Technical Leadership & Team Standards
items.description: Led 11 engineers through the delivery of 12 products, owning architecture design and technical decisions; introduced design review, code review, and release checklists, turning hands-on implementation experience into team standards reused across products.

items.title: Refactoring & Code Quality
items.description: Restructuring and refactoring code accumulated over long development cycles, reducing coupling between modules, and maintaining quality through automated testing and code review.
